title: GM & Head - CSTRA (Cybersecurity & Tech Risk Assurance)
salary_range: Negotiable, based on industry standards, experience, and last drawn salary (80% fixed, 20% variable pay)
application_fee: Rs. 750/- for General/EWS/OBC; No fee for SC/ST/PwBD
summary: State Bank of India (SBI) is recruiting for one Specialist Cadre Officer post of GM & Head - CSTRA (Cybersecurity & Tech Risk Assurance) on a fixed-term employment basis. Eligible Indian citizens can apply online from November 19, 2026, to December 03, 2026. The selection process involves shortlisting and an interview, followed by CTC negotiation.
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must possess a B. Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Cyber Security or equivalent with minimum 50% score, OR MCA, OR M. Tech/M.Sc in relevant disciplines from a recognized University/Institution.
Essential experience includes 15-20 years post-qualification in IT/Information Security, with at least 5 years in core Information Security/Cyber Security at a Senior Management Level in Banks/FIs.
Maximum age limit is 50 years as on October 31, 2026.
Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM, CCISO, CISA (must be valid as on the date of interview).
how_to_apply_steps: Register online through the link available on the SBI careers website.
Scan and upload your latest photograph and signature as specified.
Fill the application form carefully, saving information if needed (up to three edits allowed).
Submit the completed application and proceed to pay the application fee online using Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card.
After successful transaction, print the e-receipt and the system-generated online application form for future reference.
